SELECT a.connector_id, a.connector_code, a.connector_name, a.connector_type, a.description, a.auth_mode, a.auth_config, b.access_expire_time AS credential_expires_at, b.credential_state, b.renewal_mode, b.access_expire_time AS access_expires_at, b.refresh_expire_time AS refresh_expires_at, b.last_verified_at, CASE WHEN b.connector_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b.enable_flag = 'Y' AND COALESCE(b.credential_state, 'UNKNOWN') IN ('READY', 'REFRESH_NEEDED', 'EXPIRING', 'UNKNOWN') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS enable_flag FROM byai_connector_info a LEFT JOIN (SELECT connector_id, enable_flag, credential_state, renewal_mode, access_expire_time, refresh_expire_time, last_verified_at FROM (SELECT connector_id, enable_flag, credential_state, renewal_mode, access_expire_time, refresh_expire_time, last_verified_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY connector_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN enable_flag = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, update_time DESC NULLS LAST, create_time DESC, auth_id DESC ) AS row_num FROM byai_connector_auth WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status_cd = '00A') auth WHERE row_num = 1) b ON a.connector_id = b.connector_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.connector_type <> 'ACCOUNT_TEMPLATE'
AND a.connector_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY a.sort ASC, a.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM byai_connector_info WHERE connector_code = #{connectorCode} AND status_cd = '00A'
SELECT * FROM byai_connector_info WHERE connector_code = #{connectorCode} AND status_cd = '00A' FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.connector_code AS connector_id, CASE WHEN a.enable_flag = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a.credential_state, 'UNKNOWN') IN ('READY', 'REFRESH_NEEDED', 'EXPIRING', 'UNKNOWN') THEN 'connected' ELSE 'disabled' END AS status, a.auth_name AS account_name, a.credential_state, a.renewal_mode, a.access_expire_time AS access_expires_at, a.refresh_expire_time AS refresh_expires_at, a.last_verified_at FROM byai_connector_info i JOIN (SELECT connector_id, auth_name, enable_flag, credential_state, renewal_mode, access_expire_time, refresh_expire_time, last_verified_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY connector_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN enable_flag = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, update_time DESC NULLS LAST, create_time DESC, auth_id DESC ) AS row_num FROM byai_connector_auth WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status_cd = '00A') a ON a.connector_id = i.connector_id AND a.row_num = 1 WHERE i.status_cd = '00A' AND i.connector_type <> 'ACCOUNT_TEMPLATE' UNION ALL SELECT i.connector_code AS connector_id, 'connected' AS status, NULL AS account_name, 'READY' AS credential_state, 'NONE' AS renewal_mode, NULL AS access_expires_at, NULL AS refresh_expires_at, NULL AS last_verified_at FROM byai_connector_info i WHERE i.status_cd = '00A' AND i.connector_type <> 'ACCOUNT_TEMPLATE' AND i.auth_mode = 'NONE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai_connector_auth a WHERE a.connector_id = i.connector_id AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status_cd = '00A' )
